sections.dosage_and_administration: Take an appropriate amount of this product, apply it evenly on the facial skin, and pat and massage until absorbed.
sections.warnings_and_cautions: Please store in a dry place at room temperature [Note】 This product is for external use only and is not edible. Please keep itout of the reach of children. If it gets into your eyes, please rinse immediatelywith plenty of water. Due to individual differences in skin, it is recommendedto do a sensitivity test behind the ear before use. If you feel any discomfort,please stop using it.
